instruction: Launch VLC from the left dock and play the network stream at URL "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4"

verification.condition: Using D-Bus MPRIS, check that org.mpris.MediaPlayer2.vlc reports PlaybackStatus="Playing" and Metadata["xesam:title"]="Big Buck Bunny"
verification.expected_result: VLC is actively playing the Big Buck Bunny video and the VLC window title includes "Big Buck Bunny"
